title: “Whose Side Are You On?” Estimating Ideology of Political and News Content Using Large Language Models and Few-shot Demonstration Selection

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the political ideology (Liberal, Neutral, Conservative) of news articles and YouTube videos using Large Language Models, and evaluating how the models exhibit bias by over-relying on the known political leaning of the publisher/source rather than the actual text, particularly tested through edge cases where the content's ideology contradicts the source's typical ideology.
